title: Class 6 Science · Ch 3 Worksheet A · Food Components
instructions: Identify the food components and their roles.

questions.question: Carbohydrates give us mainly
questions.explanation: Carbohydrates like rice and roti are quick energy sources.

questions.question: Proteins help us mainly to
questions.explanation: Proteins are the body's building blocks.

questions.question: _____ is the indigestible plant material that helps in passing waste smoothly.
_____ is a mineral required for strong bones and teeth.
Vitamins are needed in large amounts every day.
questions.explanation: Vitamins are micronutrients — needed in small amounts but vital.

questions.question: Match each food group with the role it plays: carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, fibre.
questions.answer: Carbohydrates — quick energy; Proteins — growth and repair; Fats — long-lasting energy and warmth; Vitamins — protection from disease; Fibre — smooth digestion.

questions.question: For each component below, name a typical Indian food source: carbohydrate, protein, fat, vitamin, mineral.
questions.answer: Carbohydrate — rice, roti, potato. Protein — dal, paneer, eggs. Fat — ghee, peanut, butter. Vitamin — orange (vitamin C), spinach (vitamin A). Mineral — milk (calcium), spinach (iron).
questions.explanation: Tests the student's ability to connect food groups to local foods.

questions.question: Plan a balanced lunch for yourself for tomorrow. List the items and tag each with the main food groups they cover.
questions.answer: Sample plan: 2 rotis (carbohydrate), 1 bowl of dal (protein), 1 vegetable like palak (vitamins, minerals, fibre), curd (protein, calcium), salad (vitamins, fibre), water. Many similar plans accepted.
questions.explanation: Open-ended; full credit for any balanced plan.
